generation_policy.style: LocalParty soft toy arcade, orthographic, broad upper-left light, simple silhouettes, low detail
forbidden: three-quarter product shot for rotating gameplay parts

swarm_gate.notes: Fixed scenery uses the live 45-degree south-to-north view. Rotating units use exact 90-degree top-down source art.

peek_shoot.notes: All targets and obstacles use exact front view with no visible side or top face.

jobs.orientation: Every enemy faces the bottom edge. Pivot is exact cell center.

cells.content: large dark-violet boss with red plates

jobs.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 source atlas with a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, each cell 384x512, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. CAMERA: exact 90-degree orthographic top-down, no perspective, no horizon. Every enemy faces the bottom edge and is centered on the exact cell center. First row: small orange worker bug; fast yellow-violet winged bug; heavy green-charcoal armored beetle; large dark-violet boss bug with two red armor plates. Leave the second row empty hot pink. Match the LocalParty soft-toy arcade style: broad upper-left light, large rounded silhouettes, at most four material regions, readable at 48 pixels. No cast shadows, trails, debris, micro-detail, text, UI, logos, or watermark.

jobs.purpose: A fixed base plus independently rotating turret heads and projectiles
jobs.orientation: All barrels and projectile noses point exactly toward the top edge.
jobs.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 modular turret rig atlas in a strict 4x2 grid, 384x512 per cell, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. CAMERA: exact 90-degree orthographic top-down for every part, no perspective and no visible side faces. Cell 1 rotationally symmetric turret base only; cells 2-4 separate rotating turret heads with short cannon, long cannon, and pulse emitter; every barrel points exactly upward and every rotation pivot is at cell center. Cells 5-7 contain a gold shell, violet bolt, and compact missile with noses pointing upward and no trails. Cell 8 contains a simple cyan selection ring. Use simple chunky LocalParty forms, broad lighting, and no cast shadow. Never combine the base and head. Never tilt a cannon toward the viewer. No detail smaller than 10 pixels, text, UI, logos, or watermark.

jobs.purpose: Fixed wall and gate modules at world z=0
jobs.orientation: Wall axis is horizontal. Show front/south face and top cap only; no side face.
jobs.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 fixed-scenery atlas in a strict 4x2 grid, 384x512 per cell, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. CAMERA: orthographic, located directly south, looking north and downward at exactly 45 degrees, yaw 0. Horizontal world lines stay horizontal. Show the south/front face and top cap of each wall piece, never a left or right side face. Cells: straight wall with flat connection seams; closed centered gate; damaged gate with identical silhouette; destroyed gate with identical frame; left end tower; right end tower; flat damage decal; flat repair decal. All wall and gate variants share one baseline, width, and camera. Use broad low-detail masonry. No diagonal wall chunk, isometric corner, surrounding ground, rubble cloud, text, logos, or watermark.

jobs.purpose: Texture mapped to the existing horizontal gameplay field
jobs.prompt: Create one seamless 1024x1024 top-down gameplay ground texture for the existing Swarm Gate plane. Exact 90-degree top-down texture view, no perspective and no horizon. Dark blue-gray fortress courtyard floor with broad stone slabs, low contrast, subtle wide seams, two or three faint worn patches, and restrained violet-blue variation. It must tile perfectly on all four edges. Keep the middle visually quiet for enemies, aim lines, projectiles, and UI. No sky, mountains, castle, wall, gate, turret, enemy, projectile, vignette, dramatic light beam, grass, debris, tiny cracks, high-frequency texture, text, logo, or watermark.

Create a 1536x1024 eight-frame top-down VFX atlas in a strict 4x2 grid, 384x512 per frame, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. Every frame has the same exact center and scale envelope. Sequence: tiny white-yellow ignition; small orange star; expanding orange disk; peak with six large lobes; peak ring and four large debris shapes; contracting ring; three fading embers; almost empty final frame. Adjacent frames must form one continuous 320 ms animation. Use only 5-10 large shapes per frame. No detailed smoke, random design changes, camera changes, dense particles, text, UI, logos, watermark, or debris crossing a cell boundary.

jobs.purpose: Targets rise vertically from behind fixed covers
jobs.orientation: Exact front view, common bottom baseline, body centered.
jobs.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 shooting-gallery target atlas in a strict 4x2 grid, 384x512 per cell, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. CAMERA: exact orthographic front view, pitch 0, yaw 0, roll 0. All characters face the viewer directly, share the same bottom baseline, and are centered. Cells: surprised white chicken; orange bug bandit; violet armored beetle target; boss chicken with two simple shoulder pads; friendly white chicken holding one plain white flag; gold bonus target; two empty cells. Use neutral standing poses because rise, bob, recoil, and death are animated by code. Use broad low-detail LocalParty forms readable at 64 pixels. No three-quarter pose, visible top surface, weapon, projectile, crosshair, action trail, cast shadow, text, UI, logos, or watermark.

jobs.purpose: Front-facing cover art aligned with rectangular hitboxes
jobs.orientation: Exact front view, identical bottom baseline and usable width.
jobs.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 cover atlas in a strict 4x2 grid, 384x512 per cell, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. CAMERA: exact orthographic front view with no top face and no side face. Every obstacle shares the same bottom baseline and usable width and aligns with a rectangular hitbox. Cells: intact wooden crate with broad planks; identical cracked crate with two large cracks; low broad-block stone cover; flat violet metal cover; destroyed crate frame A with two large pieces inside the original bounds; frame B with pieces lower; simple round metal cover; empty cell. No perspective, isometric view, floor, cast shadow, fragments outside bounds, detail smaller than 10 pixels, text, UI, logos, or watermark.

jobs.purpose: 400 ms front-facing non-graphic target death animation
jobs.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 eight-frame shooting-gallery death VFX atlas in a strict 4x2 grid, 384x512 per frame, on perfectly uniform #FF00A8. CAMERA: exact orthographic front view. All frames share the same center, bottom baseline, scale, and character identity. Sequence: compact impact star; silhouette squash with one flash; silhouette separates into four large playful pieces; pieces move outward; pieces shrink and fade; two pieces remain; one small sparkle; nearly empty. The sequence must animate continuously over 400 ms and remain playful and non-graphic. No gore, smoke cloud, unrelated explosion, camera change, dense particles, text, UI, logos, watermark, or pieces crossing cell boundaries.

steps: crop each cell to alpha bounds while preserving pivot
pack approved sprites into 1536x1024 4x2 runtime atlases
write frame rectangles, source sizes, pivots, muzzle points, and animation timing to manifest JSON
verify zero opaque pixels touch an atlas cell edge
packing.do_not: Do not ask an image model to redraw an approved set as one final atlas.

acceptance_checks: Every rotating gameplay sprite is exact top-down.
Every gallery sprite is exact front view.
Wall modules share camera, baseline, width, and connection edges.
Turret base and head are separate and share the same pivot.
Animation frames preserve center, baseline, scale, and identity.
Ground texture tiles on all four edges and contains no game objects.
All assets remain readable at their minimum runtime size.
No silhouette or effect touches a cell boundary.
